name: Buffet Carving Station (Roast Turkey, Prime Rib, or Ham)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Cabanas / Disney Treasure · Marceline Market
whyItWorks: Hand-carved roasted turkey breast, tenderloin/roast beef, and glazed ham paired with peeled mashed potatoes and savory gravy give you a 9.5/10 hot Thanksgiving-style lunch every day at sea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Head straight to the carving board at Cabanas or Marceline Market, ask for lean center slices (no peppercorn bark), and pair with whipped mashed potatoes, gravy, and a soft white dinner roll.
watchOuts: Outer black peppercorn or herb crusts on carved beef
